verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible left-to-right banner order (crowd, quote, attribution) with a clear gap between the crowd and the quote. Its flaws: the crowd shrinks to a thumbnail that no longer reads as a crowd, the attribution is tiny with a ragged two-line wrap, and there is dead space on the far right. B has the same structure, but the cropped crowd runs straight into 'NEVER DOUBT' and 'COMMITTED', so figures collide with the headline. Its attribution is even smaller and hard to read at banner size, and the right side is just as empty.
